THE ANALYSIS
The logged data showed no symptoms across three exposure days and no washout flare, which by itself would support a Safe verdict, but you confirmed the logs did not capture how you actually felt during that period. You described a consistent low grade feeling of being off each evening after eating dairy, which is a pattern that goes beyond the clean zero symptom baseline you had during elimination. That gap between what was logged and what you experienced is enough to shift the verdict one step toward Limit rather than confirming Safe.
WORTH KNOWING
This isn't necessarily permanent. Sensitivities can shift over time. After completing your full program, you can choose to retest any food and update its verdict.
